tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background of every screen and document (#e6e2dd, the sand the team already uses for documents). Body text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`; cards sit on it as `surface`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table bodies and the sidebar. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`; separate it from `canvas` with a `line` hairline.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elements that float above the page: dialogs, menus, popovers, the selected agenda day. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`; pair with `shadow-lg`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells cut into a surface: table headers, zebra rows, segmented-control track, disabled fields. Text on it is `ink` or `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card outlines, dividers between rows. Never the only cue that a control exists — use `line-strong` for that.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Border of interactive controls (input, select, checkbox, outline button) and of the dashed pre-reserva outline; 3:1 or more on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and icons on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and every `*-tint` fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, table meta, placeholders. 4.5:1 or more on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Vastio Blue (#153e6c, the logo's blue). Fill of the primary button, selected tab and active nav item; also the mark itself. Text on it is `on-brand`. In the dark theme it lightens to blue-400.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a `brand` surface (primary button, active nav item). Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of a `brand` surface. Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand`, `brand-hover` and `brand-pressed`. White in the light theme, blue-950 in the dark theme.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet brand wash: selected row, active nav item background, info hover. Text on it is `ink` or `brand-ink`.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Links, text buttons and brand-colored icons on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `brand-tint`. 4.5:1 or more on all of them.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brass, the second brand color echoing the sparks in the logo. Fill for highlights: today marker, featured chip, star icon. Never carries a state by itself. Text on it is `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Soft brass wash behind an accent highlight. Text on it is `ink` or `accent-ink`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Brass used as text or icon on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `accent-tint`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid with a 2px gap, on every interactive element. 3:1 or more on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success / confirmed / stock OK. Fill, border or icon (3:1 or more on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`); always paired with an icon and a word. Text on it is `on-success`.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `success` fill.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a success chip, banner or row. Text on it is `success-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for the success tone on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `success-tint`. 4.5:1 or more on all of them.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning / pre-reserva / stock low. Fill, border or icon (3:1 or more on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`); always paired with an icon and a word. Text on it is `on-warning`.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `warning` fill.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a warning chip, banner or row. Text on it is `warning-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for the warning tone on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `warning-tint`. 4.5:1 or more on all of them.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger / cancelled / out of stock / destructive action. Fill, border or icon (3:1 or more on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`); always paired with an icon and a word. Text on it is `on-danger`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `danger` fill.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a danger chip, banner or row. Text on it is `danger-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for the danger tone on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `danger-tint`. 4.5:1 or more on all of them.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information / señado / neutral notice. Fill, border or icon (3:1 or more on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`); always paired with an icon and a word. Text on it is `on-info`.

tokens.name: on-info
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `info` fill.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Background of a info chip, banner or row. Text on it is `info-ink` or `ink`.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for the info tone on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-raised` and `info-tint`. 4.5:1 or more on all of them.

tokens.name: salon-avril
tokens.usage: Identity color of Avril (rojo), kept from the organization's shared calendar. Dot, bar and calendar pill only, always next to the salon's name; 3:1 or more on every surface. Not a state color.

tokens.name: salon-avril-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons for Avril (rojo) on `salon-avril-tint` and on `surface`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and login title; the only place the largest size appears. Jost.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Cover of a report or empty-state headline on desktop. Jost.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Eyebrow above a title, section label, salon name in a header. Set uppercase (`.overline` uppercases it in bundle.css); echoes the wide-tracked wordmark. Jost.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: One per screen: the page title.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section title inside a page; dialog title.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Group label inside a card or form; table-group heading.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Registrá la seña para confirmar la fecha.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: La pre-reserva aparta la fecha mientras negociás con el cliente.
styles.usage: Default text and every input value (16px stops mobile browsers from zooming into fields).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Table cells, meta lines, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, table headers, tab labels, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Smallest text: timestamps, legends, badges. Never below this size.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button label, in all three variants and sizes.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: KPI value in a Stat tile. Jost with tabular figures (`.stat` sets tabular-nums in bundle.css).

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Quantities in steppers, stock rows and movements. Jost with tabular figures so columns of numbers align.

styles.name: numeral-sm
styles.usage: Numeric table cells, dates and times in dense lists. Jost with tabular figures.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label; inner gap of a chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls (button group, chip row); vertical gap label→input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips, table cells (dense) and list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones, gap between form fields, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards, page gutter on tablet and desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm around a page title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Large section separation, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero and login padding.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Maximum vertical whitespace.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of a small button or input; dense desktop tables only. Never the only tap target on a phone.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects and tabs; the minimum touch target.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height for bar and depósito staff working on a tablet or phone during an event: stepper buttons, primary actions on movement screens.

tokens.name: sidebar-w
tokens.usage: Width of the desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of page content; center it on wider screens.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Agenda pills, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, table row hover, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, avatars, segmented control and switch.

shadow.note: Blue-tinted shadows in the light theme; in the dark theme depth comes from lighter surfaces and heavier black shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Resting buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards that can be picked up or opened (event card, movement card).

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the mobile bottom sheet.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the agenda's weekday row.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bar and bottom navigation.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and banners over dialogs.

breakpoint.note: Media queries cannot read custom properties; use these values literally. Design phone first: phone < 640, tablet 640–959, desktop 960+.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone → tablet: two-column forms, side-by-side cards.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet → desktop: the sidebar replaces the bottom navigation.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Wide desktop: agenda can show side panel next to the calendar.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls (text is exempt from contrast, but keep the label readable).
